content.short: Truffle is the leading Ethereum development environment to build, deploy and test smart contracts.
content.description: Truffle provides a comprehensive framework for developing, testing, and deploying Ethereum smart contracts on the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM). Paired with Ganache, it can simulate blockchains locally with a single click. Developers rely on Truffle for smart contract management, a streamlined development workflow, and straightforward network management across projects and environments. It offers a broad range of features, including smart contract management, a user-friendly development process and environment, and smooth network management.
